summaryCn: 中山大学软件工程本科生，学术兴趣聚焦于人工智能与软件工程的交叉领域，主要包括 AI4SE 与 SE4AI，尤其关注大语言模型赋能软件工程、智能代码生成，以及面向大模型的可信性评测；同时对 Agentic RAG 与 AI Agents 保持兴趣。
intro: Hi, I'm Peiliang Cai, a Software Engineering student at Sun Yat-sen University.

My academic interests lie at the intersection of Software Engineering and Artificial Intelligence, with a primary focus on AI4SE and SE4AI. I am particularly interested in LLM-powered software engineering, intelligent code generation, and trustworthy evaluation of large language models. I also maintain a secondary interest in Agentic RAG and AI agents.
